# Founder Stories

### Laurent Gil, Leon Kuperman & Yuri Frayman

Founders, Cast AI

![cast ai logo](https://www.cotacapital.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/cast-ai-logo.svg)

## Transforming Cloud Cost Management with AI

The founding team of CAST AI brings together a wealth of entrepreneurial experience that spans decades in the technology industry. Laurent Gil, Leon Kuperman, and Yuri Frayman co-founded the company in 2019 after experiencing firsthand the challenges of managing cloud costs at scale during their previous venture, Zenedge, a cybersecurity company that was acquired by Oracle in 2018.

Their journey into cloud optimization began with a common frustration: skyrocketing cloud bills as their previous business scaled. This pain point inspired them to build a platform that would optimize cloud infrastructure and reduce costs without manual intervention, creating a solution that could benefit every cloud-native company struggling with similar challenges.

CAST AI’s innovative approach uses AI-driven automation to analyze and optimize Kubernetes workloads across multiple cloud providers. Their platform continuously monitors clusters and applies real-time changes to maintain optimal configuration, addressing a critical need as companies increasingly shift toward cloud-native architectures and face the challenges of managing complex, multi-cloud environments.

Laurent Gil is the Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer of CAST AI, a Cota Capital-backed US company that analyzes a company’s spend on cloud services—AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure—then cuts Kubernetes cost by half through automated optimization.

Kubernetes (also known as “K8s”), is an open-source system for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Google runs billions of Kubernetes containers a week, and the technology has industry support from VMWare, Mesosphere, Docker, Microsoft Azure, and AWS.

In this interview with Bobby Yazdani, Cota Capital Co-Founder & Partner, Laurent discusses CAST AI’s technology and his fellow co-founders’ experiences growing the company.

More about CAST AI – [https://www.cast.ai](https://www.cast.ai/)

#### ABOUT FOUNDERS IN 5

Cota Capital’s “Founders in 5” video series offers insightful conversations with founders and other leaders across Enterprise Infrastructure, Enterprise Automation, FinTech, and HealthTech. Bobby Yazdani is co-founder and partner of Cota Capital, a technology investment firm that partners with exceptional teams to build and grow timeless companies enabling the future.

### Fun Facts

- Before CAST AI, Laurent and Yuri built Viewdle, one of the earliest machine learning startups, which was later acquired by Google
- The founding team’s prior company, Zenedge, inspired the creation of CAST AI after they struggled with managing cloud costs
- The company is headquartered in Miami, FL
